Preserve assigned character identities, rigid handmade masks, body proportions and reference costume states. Masks remain inanimate; emotion comes through breathing, posture, hands and timing. References anchor design; the written lighting governs illumination. No readable titles or dialogue are generated.
LOCATION AND LIGHT
Preparation room: hard neutral overhead light, warm spill at left wall, continuous floor and east/right counter. Escape passage: recessed cool utility lamps, rounded stone openings and a dark exterior exit ahead. Preserve practical light and architecture; transitions occur only at cuts.
START STATE AND BLOCKING
Room camera south: fully covered body lies center-left. Younger kneels at its right side facing left, in original prisoner clothing. Armayil stands center-right; Garmayil returns through north/rear door. Exactly one escape robe is folded on the east/right counter. Covered body remains fully concealed and motionless.

SHOT 10A | 00s to 06s | 6 seconds
40mm close handheld from south. Garmayil enters, collects the single robe and wraps it around Younger’s shoulders. Younger refuses to rise, keeping his left hand on the covering cloth. Armayil crouches on his right and offers support under the right upper arm. Garmayil supports the left. Younger shakes his head and clings for one final moment.
SHOT 10B | 06s to 11s | 5 seconds
35mm continuous handheld view from the same side. The two rescuers help Younger stand. He slowly releases the cloth and reaches back once as they guide him toward the rear door. Camera follows one step and loses perfect composition briefly. The body stays on the floor; only the one escape robe moves with Younger.
SHOT 10C | 11s to 15s | 4 seconds
28mm in the escape passage, camera ahead of the three facing back toward them. Younger center in the robe, Armayil left, Garmayil right. The rescuers stop at a service turn and release him. Younger takes two reluctant steps toward camera, turns his head back to them, then continues. Camera retreats, keeping his unsteady balance readable.
END STATE AND EDIT
Younger has left the rescuers, wearing the single escape robe over his original clothes. Armayil and Garmayil remain behind at the passage turn.
SOUND
Cloth under fingers, knees shifting on floor, strained breaths, weight lifting, uneven footsteps and the deeper echo of the passage.
NO MUSIC. NO DIALOGUE.
